qualification.details: Qualification: M.V.Sc / Ph.D. in Animal Science; Master's degree in Animal Science with at least 55% (traditional system), 60% (trimester system) or 70% (semester system) marks or equivalent grade, from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University; NET by UGC/ICAR/CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET; Ph.D. holders under UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016 are exempted from NET/SLET/SET | Other conditions: | Candidates must attend the interview at their own cost The appointment is temporary and can be terminated at any time without notice

how_to_apply: Fill in your details in the application form given as the annexure of the notice.
Bring two copies of the filled form with photographs.
Bring all original documents of qualification and two attested copies.
Appear at the Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti on 01.12.2026 at 12.00 noon.
Do not send the application in advance under any circumstances.
important_instructions: Applications must not be sent in advance under any circumstances The post is for teaching Animal Science to B.Sc. (Agri) students

content_sections.heading: UAS Dharwad Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. Dean(Agri)/KruMaha/601-C/2026-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download UAS Dharwad notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: M.V.Sc / Ph.D. in Animal Science; Master's degree in Animal Science with at least 55% (traditional system), 60% (trimester system) or 70% (semester system) marks or equivalent grade, from an Indian University or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University; NET by UGC/ICAR/CSIR or a similar test accredited by the UGC like SLET/SET; Ph.D. holders under UGC Regulations 2009 or 2016 are exempted from NET/SLET/SET Other conditions: Candidates must attend the interview at their own cost The appointment is temporary and can be terminated at any time without notice

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Temporary appointment for a period not exceeding 179 days Appointment may be terminated at any time without giving any reason The temporary appointment gives no right of any kind to direct appointment in the University of Agricultural Sciences

content_sections.heading: How Will UAS Dharwad Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Selection is by walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Two copies of the application form filled in the prescribed format Photographs All original documents relating to qualification Two attested copies of the documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UAS Dharwad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in your details in the application form given as the annexure of the notice. Bring two copies of the filled form with photographs. Bring all original documents of qualification and two attested copies. Appear at the Office of the Dean (Agri), College of Agriculture, Hanumanamatti on 01.12.2026 at 12.00 noon. Do not send the application in advance under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications must not be sent in advance under any circumstances The post is for teaching Animal Science to B.Sc. (Agri) students
